component.name: RowItem
component.script:
sub onContent() c = m.top.itemContent if c = invalid then return m.top.findNode("title").text = c.title print "PROBE|item|content|content=" + c.title + " rowIndex=" + m.top.rowIndex.toStr() + " index=" + m.top.index.toStr() end sub
sub onSize() fill = m.top.findNode("fill") fill.width = m.top.width fill.height = m.top.height title = m.top.findNode("title") title.width = m.top.width title.height = m.top.height end sub
